evidence.title: GitHub - excalidraw/excalidraw: Virtual whiteboard for sketching hand-drawn like diagrams

name: Excalidraw
summary: Open-source virtual whiteboard for sketching hand-drawn-style diagrams in the browser, with end-to-end encrypted collaboration.
description: A canvas whiteboard for diagramming, wireframing and sketching with a hand-drawn look: infinite canvas, dark mode, shape libraries, image support, and export to PNG, SVG, clipboard or .excalidraw JSON files. Collaboration works through shareable end-to-end encrypted rooms, and the editor is also published as the @excalidraw/excalidraw npm component to embed in your own app.
contains: infinite canvas with hand-drawn style, dark mode and shape libraries
export to PNG, SVG, clipboard and .excalidraw JSON
collaboration via shareable rooms, end-to-end encrypted
